paper.title_en: Probing Graviton Mass with MeerKAT PTA and SKA-PTA Forecasts
paper.abstract_en: In this study, we derive constraints on the graviton mass using the 4.5-year data release from the MeerKAT Pulsar Timing Array (MPTA) and provide forecasts for the upcoming Square Kilometre Array PTA (SKA-PTA). By modeling the modified dispersion relation and the corresponding tensor correlation function for massive gravitons, we perform Bayesian inference on the angular-correlation measurements under three noise configurations. Our 90\% credible upper limits on the graviton mass span $m_g < (2.10$-$2.58) \times 10^{-23}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$. Including monopolar and dipolar contributions does not significantly alter these bounds, confirming that the constraints are driven by the quadrupolar tensor correlation. All results remain fully consistent with general relativity. For SKA-PTA, we forecast sensitivities down to $m_g \sim 10^{-24}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$ with a 10-year observing baseline and $m_g \sim 10^{-25}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$ with a 50-year observing baseline, representing order-of-magnitude improvements over current limits. This work demonstrates the power of current and future PTA observations to test fundamental aspects of gravity in the nanohertz band.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文利用MeerKAT脉冲星计时阵列4.5年数据给出引力子质量上限，并对SKA-PTA做出量级提升的灵敏度预测，主题与PTA及引力基础检验直接相关；方法上明确采用修改色散关系与张量关联函数的贝叶斯推断，并讨论三种噪声配置与单极/偶极贡献的影响，信息完整、可读性强。元数据缺少DOI、期刊引用与引用数，故元数据与社区信号评分偏低；但作者数量少、预印本较新，零引用不应扣分。综合判断值得点开阅读以评估其建模细节与统计处理。
decision.title_zh: 利用MeerKAT PTA探测引力子质量及SKA-PTA预报
decision.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们利用MeerKAT脉冲星计时阵列（MPTA）的4.5年数据发布来推导对引力子质量的限制，并为即将建成的平方公里阵列脉冲星计时阵列（SKA-PTA）提供预报。通过建模有质量引力子的修改色散关系及相应的张量关联函数，我们在三种噪声配置下对角关联测量进行贝叶斯推断。我们对引力子质量的90\%可信上限范围为 $m_g < (2.10$-$2.58) \times 10^{-23}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$。纳入单极和偶极贡献并未显著改变这些界限，这证实约束主要由四极张量关联驱动。所有结果均与广义相对论完全一致。对于SKA-PTA，我们预报在10年观测基线下的灵敏度可达 $m_g \sim 10^{-24}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$，在50年观测基线下可达 $m_g \sim 10^{-25}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$，相对当前限制代表数量级的改进。这项工作展示了当前和未来PTA观测在纳赫兹频段检验引力基本性质方面的能力。
